detail.question: Combien de commandes par mois en 2017 ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH achats_2017 AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts
    FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
    WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) <  TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', ts) AS mois,
       COUNT(*)               AS nb_commandes
FROM achats_2017
GROUP BY mois
ORDER BY mois
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires mois par mois en 2018 ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH ventes AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS purchase_ts,
        oi.price,
        oi.freight_value
    FROM entrepot."orders" o
    JOIN entrepot."order_items" oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(purchase_ts, 'YYYY-MM') AS mois,
    ROUND(SUM(price + freight_value), 2) AS chiffre_daffaires
FROM ventes
GROUP BY mois
ORDER BY mois
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quelles categories de produits ont le panier moyen le plus eleve, avec leur nom en anglais ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH items AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        (oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS montant
    FROM entrepot."order_items" oi
)
SELECT
    p.product_category_name AS categorie_fr,
    pcnt.product_category_name_english AS categorie_en,
    AVG(i.montant) AS panier_moyen
FROM items i
JOIN entrepot."products" p
    ON i.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" pcnt
    ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
GROUP BY

    pcnt.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY panier_moyen DESC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Les vendeurs de quels etats livrent le plus vite ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH livraisons_par_vendeur AS (
    SELECT
        s.seller_state AS etat,
        TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts_achat,
        TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts_livraison
    FROM entrepot."order_items" oi
    JOIN entrepot."orders" o USING (order_id)
    JOIN entrepot."sellers" s USING (seller_id)
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    etat,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('day', ts_achat, ts_livraison))::DOUBLE AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM livraisons_par_vendeur
GROUP BY etat
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours ASC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quelle est la note moyenne par categorie de produit, en anglais, pour les categories evaluees au moins cinq cents fois ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH avis_par_produit AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id,
           r.review_score
    FROM entrepet."order_reviews" AS r
    JOIN entrepet."order_items" AS oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN entrepet."products" AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN entrepet."product_category_name_translation" AS pcnt
        ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
    WHERE r.review_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT pcnt.product_category_name_english AS categorie_produit,
       AVG(a.review_score) AS note_moyenne,
       COUNT(*) AS nb_evaluations
FROM avis_par_produit AS a
JOIN entrepet."products" AS p ON a.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN entrepet."product_category_name_translation" AS pcnt
    ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
GROUP BY pcnt.product_category_name_english
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Les commentaires des clients mecontents sont-ils plus longs que ceux des clients satisfaits ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH commentaires AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN 'mécontent'
            WHEN review_score >= 4 THEN 'satisfait'
        END AS type_client,
        CHAR_LENGTH(review_comment_message) AS longueur_message
    FROM entrepot."order_reviews"
    WHERE review_comment_message IS NOT NULL
      AND review_score IS NOT NULL
      AND (review_score <= 2 OR review_score >= 4)
)

    type_client AS type_client,
    AVG(longueur_message) AS longueur_moyenne_commentaire
FROM commentaires

detail.question: Le delai de livraison depend-il de l'etat du client ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH delais AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_state AS etat,
        TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS date_livraison,
        TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS date_achat
    FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
    JOIN entrepot."customers" AS c
        ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
      AND TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    etat AS etat_client,
    COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes,
    ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', date_achat::DATE, date_livraison::DATE)), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM delais
GROUP BY etat
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours DESC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quelle est la repartition des clients entre Sao Paulo et le reste du pays ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_clients
    FROM entrepot."customers"
),
repartition AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN 'Sao Paulo' ELSE 'Reste du pays' END AS region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS nb_clients
    FROM entrepot."customers"
    GROUP BY 1
)

detail.question: Le chiffre d'affaires du second semestre 2017 est-il superieur a celui du premier ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH
    -- Transactions du 1er semestre 2017
    premier_semestre AS (
        SELECT
            oi.price + oi.freight_value AS montant
        FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
        JOIN entrepot."orders" AS o
            ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
        WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
          AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) <  TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01'
    ),
    -- Transactions du 2e semestre 2017
    second_semestre AS (
        SELECT
            oi.price + oi.freight_value AS montant
        FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
        JOIN entrepot."orders" AS o
            ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
        WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01'
          AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) <  TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
    ),
    -- Totaux par semestre
    totaux AS (
        SELECT
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(montant), 0) FROM premier_semestre) AS chiffre_affaires_1er_semestre,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(montant), 0) FROM second_semestre) AS chiffre_affaires_2eme_semestre
    )
SELECT
    chiffre_affaires_1er_semestre,
    chiffre_affaires_2eme_semestre,
    CASE WHEN chiffre_affaires_2eme_semestre > chiffre_affaires_1er_semestre THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS superieur
FROM totaux
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Le delai de livraison moyen a-t-il change entre 2017 et 2018 ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS purchase_ts,
        TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS delivered_ts
    FROM entrepot."orders"
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
      AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
delays AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(year FROM delivered_ts) AS annee,
        DATEDIFF('day', purchase_ts, delivered_ts) AS delai_jours
    FROM base
    WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM delivered_ts) IN (2017, 2018)
)
SELECT
    annee AS annee,
    ROUND(AVG(delai_jours), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM delays
GROUP BY annee
ORDER BY annee
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quelle marge realisons-nous sur chaque categorie de produits ?

WITH marge_par_categorie AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_category_name AS categorie,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenu_total,
        SUM(oi.freight_value) AS frais_total,
        SUM(oi.price - oi.freight_value) AS marge_total

ORDER BY marge_total DESC
